notes: Visually checked original PDF page 12 using digests/scratch-privacy/2025-enccluster/page-012.png; cross-checked page text and source PDF SHA-256.
Both panels use insight result 0. The chart uses upstream ratio only; the supporting table uses IID/non-IID accuracy deltas and encryption seconds. No mixed-unit chart is created.
The one upstream/time pair supplied for both splits is retained, not assigned separately to IID and non-IID. The unencrypted FedAvg+clustering encryption dash remains a dash.
Results are from arXiv:2406.09152v1 (13 June 2024), not blended with the 2025 PMC paper or 2024 workshop version. No dispersion is reported.
The preprint prose reverses approximate SEFL speed/traffic reduction factors. Raw Table 3 values are used instead; no speedup ratio is inferred.
Architecture coverage in Table 5 is omitted to keep one fixed-setting comparison. These panels do not support general privacy guarantees or end-to-end runtime claims.
